# Daniel Philip Johnson

> Full-stack developer specialising in frontend architecture, web performance and calm, maintainable systems. This file is a markdown index of the site for AI agents.

## Pages

- [Home](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/): Portfolio overview and selected work
- [About](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/about): Background, experience and approach
- [Projects](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/projects): Selected projects and case studies
- [Blog](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/blog): All articles on frontend architecture, web performance and engineering principles
- [Notes](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/notes): Short engineering notes
- [Engineering](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/engineering): Engineering guides
- [MCP](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/mcp): Model Context Protocol explained with analogies
- [MCP Deep Dive](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/mcp/deep-dive): Deeper look at the Model Context Protocol
- [Zen](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/zen): Zen principles applied to software craft
- [Tao](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/tao): The Tao of Programming
- [Now](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/now): What Daniel is currently working on
- [Social](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/social): Links and profiles
- [Contact](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/contact): How to get in touch
- [Privacy Policy](https://danielphilipjohnson.com/privacy): How this site handles data: no analytics, no tracking cookies, no ads
